classification_definitions.integration: Core assertion materially traverses genuine project service/API/network/process/store/runtime boundary.
classification_definitions.unit: Local predicates/state machines or synthetic/mock dependency records; incidental setup is insufficient.
classification_definitions.mixed: Independent material local-only and genuine boundary assertion blocks coexist.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Insufficient source/mapping evidence to support the other categories.

member-transport.boundary: Production http.Transport header limit is asserted by http.Client.Do against a real Unix-domain listener serving a 5000-byte header; no live member service is involved.

native-path-predicate.boundary: Pure string/path validation; /sys/fs/cgroup is only returned as text.

native-xattrs.boundary: Production unix.Setxattr/Removexattr/Getxattr operate on real temporary directories and assertion reads back exact presence/absence. This does not exercise systemd-oomd.

native-resources.boundary: Production writes and reads ordinary temporary files to set workload protections, weights and finite CPU cap, with actual xattr clearing; no cgroup kernel policy is exercised.

native-reservation.boundary: Production traverses actual temporary hierarchy and os.ReadFile values of ancestor/service/supervisor/runner resource files; test mutates those files between calls. The signed reserve is a supplied integer; no signature verification or real kernel reservation.

native-quota.boundary: Production walks actual ancestor directories and reads cpu.max files before selecting quota. Tests change ancestor files to observe tightened result/refusal; availableCPUs is injected. No affinity syscall or kernel throttling is exercised.

native-prepare-refusal.boundary: Actual os.ReadFile(cgroup.procs) refusal or os.OpenFile(missing cgroup.subtree_control) failure happens before os.MkdirAll; test os.Stat verifies no runner directory was created. Synthetic regular filesystem only.

native-traversal.boundary: Production os.Lstat reads actual directory permissions and ownership throughout ancestors; chmod/chown affect the asserted acceptance/refusal. It reasons about supplied workload identity rather than actually executing traversal as tenant.

native-stat-parser.boundary: verifyNativeExecNice uses only passed bytes; synthetic process-stat fixtures do not read /proc or launch a process.

native-oom-file.boundary: Production os.ReadFile validates initial score and os.WriteFile plus readback resets negative score; test independently reads exact retained/reset file bytes. Regular temp files, not /proc authorization or kernel OOM behavior.

native-extra-file-count.boundary: validNativeExecRequest and validateNativeTargetExtraFileCount are local predicates; launchNativeWorkload returns at count validation before capabilities/pipes/child start, so exec.Command construction is incidental.

native-fd-protocol.boundary: Default root launches same test executable and observes child success; child calls production remapNativeTargetExtraFiles which performs F_GETFD/Dup3/Close; actual inherited content, sentinel and pipe netpoll readback support the assertion.
